key_rationale: While headline CPI inflation at 5.10% remains within the tolerance band, the persistence of food inflation at 8.30% necessitates continued vigilance to ensure price stability. Given the robust GVA growth of 6.80% and the need to anchor inflation expectations, maintaining the current repo rate of 6.50% and the stance of withdrawal of accommodation remains appropriate to durably align inflation with the 4.00% target.
